findings.text: non-blocking: the repaired call site is not held. tests/test_omp_dialect.py:123 imports `_prompt_file_text` from this module and asserts on the function alone, so restoring `prompt_path.write_text(plan.stdin_text, encoding="utf-8")` here — the exact defect the review filed — leaves the whole of tests/test_omp_dialect.py green and empties an argv-prompt run's prompt.txt again. reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1959 has the same expression with no test at all. A case that drives dispatch() or change_lane() and reads the written prompt.txt would hold it.

non-blocking: the repair landed in two files outside the node's declared write paths. reckon/crew/dispatch.py and reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py were not among the six granted paths, and unlike the earlier fixture relocation (granted in writing by resume-1-advice.txt) no re-grant for these two is recorded in the run; the manifest's resume_brief asks the coordinator to extend write_paths after the fact, so the record on disk disagrees with the diff until that is done.

justifications.fit: reckon/_backends.py:438 adds a dataclass field with a mechanism-level comment and keeps it out of as_dict (reckon/_backends.py:443), following the surrounding LaunchPlan shape, and no added symbol carries a plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every element of the coordinator's three-item directive is present at the reviewed head: reckon/_backends.py:2857, reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3373 and tests/test_omp_dialect.py:366.
justifications.reuse: no owner of a git-identity carry exists in reckon production code (GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL appears only in tests) and the identity case extends launch_plan's existing environment composition rather than forking it; reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1959 restates `stdin_text or prompt` inline instead of importing _prompt_file_text, presumably to avoid a cycle, which is duplication of two lines rather than of a mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: reckon/crew/dispatch.py and reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py are changed although the node's declared write paths list neither, and the run record records the shortfall rather than a re-grant.
